established_status: Pure Einstein gravity has a nonzero two-loop divergence as a finite-parameter perturbative QFT, while quantum GR is predictive as a Wilsonian EFT at low energy.
not_a_claim: This is not evidence that classical GR or low-energy gravitational EFT is internally inconsistent.
resolution_evidence: A quantum theory with a positive physical state space, controlled UV behaviour, a well-defined observable map, and matching to the Einstein EFT including calculable Wilson coefficients.
successor_obligation: State cutoff/UV completion, physical degrees of freedom, unitarity, causality and the Einstein limit.

established_status: A small positive effective cosmological constant fits the background expansion. Its radiative stability and relation to quantum vacuum contributions are unexplained.
not_a_claim: A fitted Lambda is not an observational failure of GR; the seam is explanatory and radiative.
resolution_evidence: A mechanism that predicts or technically stabilizes the observed vacuum curvature while remaining compatible with phase transitions, local gravity and quantum EFT.
successor_obligation: Reproduce late acceleration and show radiative stability across known thresholds without hidden retuning.

structural_equation: \exists\ \gamma:[0,\lambda_*)\to\mathcal X\ \text{causal geodesic with finite }\lambda_*\text{ and no extension under theorem assumptions}
established_status: Singularity theorems establish causal geodesic incompleteness under specified focusing, causal and global assumptions. They do not identify a physical point of infinite density or a unique completion.
not_a_claim: Not every GR solution is singular and observations of black-hole exteriors do not directly observe an interior singularity.
resolution_evidence: A globally specified extension or replacement with well-posed evolution, finite observables, and recovery of GR outside the high-curvature region.
successor_obligation: Demonstrate extension, hyperbolicity, stability, entropy accounting and observable exterior matching.

established_status: Multiple cosmological and astrophysical datasets require additional gravitating structure in the standard framework, but no microscopic dark-matter particle has been confirmed.
not_a_claim: A null WIMP search is not evidence against all dark matter, and modified-gravity alternatives must reproduce the same multi-scale evidence.
resolution_evidence: Direct/indirect/production identification with consistent relic and structure history, or an alternative gravity theory that jointly fits CMB, lensing, clusters, galaxies and growth.
successor_obligation: Supply the abundance/structure mechanism and pass direct, collider, stellar, BBN and self-interaction constraints appropriate to the model.

seam: Dark energy microphysics and possible evolution
established_status: A cosmological constant gives a successful minimal fit. DESI DR2 combinations show a dataset- and parametrization-dependent preference for evolving w(a), not a settled detection.
not_a_claim: The absence of a microphysical explanation is not an internal contradiction of LambdaCDM.
resolution_evidence: Repeated, cross-survey evidence for nonconstant w with controlled systematics, or a theory predicting Lambda and its perturbations with no forbidden fifth force or instability.
successor_obligation: Reproduce distances, growth, CMB, BAO, SNe and local-gravity constraints; state whether w=-1 exactly or dynamically.

primary_class: EMPIRICAL EXTENSION TO MINIMAL RENORMALIZABLE SM
established_status: Oscillations require nonzero mass splittings. The renormalizable SM field content gives massless neutrinos; the dimension-five operator is the minimal data-required EFT extension.
not_a_claim: The data do not yet determine Dirac versus Majorana mass, absolute ordering in all respects, or the UV mediator.
resolution_evidence: A measured absolute spectrum and lepton-number character plus a UV mechanism matching oscillations, beta decay, cosmology and charged-lepton flavour limits.
successor_obligation: Generate the observed mixing and splittings without gauge anomalies, nonunitary mixing or excluded lepton-flavour violation.

established_status: The observed baryon asymmetry is not generated in an accepted calculation by the minimal SM with its measured Higgs and standard thermal history. Sphalerons provide B+L violation but the electroweak transition is a crossover and SM CP violation is insufficient in standard scenarios.
not_a_claim: This is not a mathematical inconsistency; a primordial asymmetric boundary condition can be parametrized but is not explained.
resolution_evidence: A quantitative out-of-equilibrium calculation yielding the observed asymmetry while satisfying EDM, collider, neutrino, BBN and washout constraints.
successor_obligation: Identify Sakharov ingredients, solve transport/kinetics, and show survival through electroweak and later epochs.

seam: Inflation or an alternative origin of primordial perturbations
established_status: A nearly adiabatic, nearly scale-invariant scalar spectrum is well measured. The generating field content, initial quantum state and reheating history are not uniquely selected.
not_a_claim: Inflation is a broad mechanism class, not a single verified Lagrangian; alternatives are not excluded merely by being alternatives.
resolution_evidence: A complete background and perturbation history predicting scalar/tensor/non-Gaussian observables, reheating and BBN-compatible initial conditions.
successor_obligation: Recover the observed spectrum and solve horizon/flatness or explain why those diagnostics are replaced.

established_status: The measured electroweak scale is radiatively sensitive to heavy thresholds in many UV completions. The SM as a renormalized QFT is internally consistent without a naturalness postulate.
not_a_claim: Quadratic sensitivity is not by itself an observed anomaly or a regulator-independent proof of new particles near the weak scale.
resolution_evidence: A symmetry, dynamics or UV boundary condition that quantitatively stabilizes or predicts the hierarchy and survives collider/flavour/cosmological tests.
successor_obligation: State the threshold matching and tuning measure; do not count aesthetic naturalness as a fatal empirical gate.

established_status: QCD permits CP violation, yet neutron-EDM limits require an extremely small effective angle. The smallness is unexplained in the SM.
not_a_claim: A null EDM is not an inconsistency; it is a severe parameter-selection problem.
resolution_evidence: A symmetry or dynamics, such as a viable axion/PQ realization or massless-quark alternative consistent with data, that predicts the EDM and cosmology.
successor_obligation: Compute theta matching, anomaly structure, quality problem and EDM/astrophysical/cosmological bounds.

structural_equation: \mathcal L_Y=-\bar QY_dHd_R-\bar QY_u\widetilde H u_R-\bar LY_eHe_R+\mathrm{h.c.};\quad Y_f\ \text{are general complex matrices}
established_status: Masses, mixing angles and CP phases are measured inputs. Their hierarchies and textures are not predicted by the SM gauge principle.
not_a_claim: A fitted parameter is not an inconsistency, and a conjunction of texture assumptions is not automatically an explanation.
resolution_evidence: A symmetry/dynamics deriving the parameter count and numerical relations while satisfying FCNC, CP, rare-decay and collider bounds.
successor_obligation: Match CKM/PMNS and masses with a controlled spurion structure and no excluded flavour-changing effects.

structural_equation: N_g=3;\quad \mathcal A_{\rm local}^{(1\ generation)}=0\ \text{and}\ N_{\rm SU(2)\ doublets}^{(1\ generation)}=4\equiv0\pmod2
established_status: Anomaly cancellation occurs generation by generation and therefore does not fix N_g=3 in the minimal four-dimensional SM.
not_a_claim: The repeated spectrum is not evidence for any particular algebraic or geometric model.
resolution_evidence: A construction in which exactly three chiral families follow from topology, representation theory or dynamics and all extra states/defects are controlled.
successor_obligation: Prove chirality, anomaly cancellation and family number; recover observed mixing and exclude unwanted mirrors.

seam: Cosmological initial state and thermodynamic arrow
structural_equation: \rho(t_0),\ \gamma_{ij}(t_0),\ K_{ij}(t_0)\ \text{satisfy constraints};\quad S_{\rm coarse}(t_{\rm early})\ll S_{\rm max}
established_status: Field equations require a state and constrained initial data. The observed low-entropy past and perturbation state are not fixed by the GR+SM action.
not_a_claim: Deterministic equations do not eliminate the need for boundary data.
resolution_evidence: A measure, boundary principle or dynamical attractor that predicts the relevant initial state and produces testable correlations without circular conditioning.
successor_obligation: Specify the state/measure and demonstrate normalizability, stability and observational consequences.

structural_equation: S_{\rm BH}=A/(4G\hbar);\quad \rho_{\rm pure}\xrightarrow{\rm semiclassical\ evaporation}\rho_{\rm thermal}\ \text{if no correlations/remnant/interior channel}
established_status: Semiclassical reasoning creates a tension between horizon thermality, complete evaporation and unitary quantum evolution. Observations probe exteriors, not the full quantum information map.
not_a_claim: No experiment has established nonunitarity, and the paradox is not a theorem that every candidate resolution fails.
resolution_evidence: A unitary or explicitly nonunitary quantum model with calculable Page curve/information channel, controlled local observables and black-hole phenomenology.
successor_obligation: State Hilbert space, observables, horizon/interior map and causal structure; recover Hawking/EFT behaviour where valid.

seam: Global form of the Standard Model gauge group
structural_equation: G_{\rm SM}=\big[SU(3)_C\times SU(2)_L\times U(1)_Y\big]/\Gamma,\quad \Gamma\in\{1,\mathbb Z_2,\mathbb Z_3,\mathbb Z_6\}
established_status: The known local spectrum fixes the Lie algebra but not uniquely the faithful global gauge group; differences occur in line operators, monopoles and allowed heavy charges.
not_a_claim: This does not change ordinary perturbative SM predictions at accessible energies.
resolution_evidence: Observation of suitable line/topological response, monopole or fractionally charged spectrum, or a UV construction with experimentally distinguishable consequences.
successor_obligation: Declare the global group, bundle classes, one-form symmetries and anomaly constraints.

established_status: High-scale extrapolation often places the SM near a metastability boundary; the conclusion depends on top-mass interpretation, alpha_s, matching and higher-dimensional operators.
not_a_claim: A metastable vacuum with lifetime longer than cosmological history is not inconsistent.
resolution_evidence: Improved inputs and a UV-complete scalar/gravity sector yielding a gauge-consistent decay calculation and cosmological vacuum history.
successor_obligation: Compute RG-improved potential, bounce and thermal history with uncertainty propagation.

seam: Accidental baryon/lepton symmetries and proton stability
structural_equation: \mathcal L_{\rm SMEFT}\supset C_{qqql}\,qqql/\Lambda^2+\cdots;\quad B,L\ \text{are accidental at dimension }4
established_status: Renormalizable SM interactions conserve baryon and lepton number perturbatively (with electroweak anomaly qualifications), while generic higher-dimensional operators need suppression.
not_a_claim: Observed proton longevity does not prove exact baryon number.
resolution_evidence: A symmetry/selection rule and UV matching that predicts proton/lepton violation rates or exact stability consistent with searches and baryogenesis.
successor_obligation: List all dangerous operators, suppression scales, anomalies and decay channels.

structural_equation: \Delta_O=(O_{\rm data}-O_{\rm baseline})/\sqrt{\sigma_{\rm data}^2+\sigma_{\rm theory}^2};\quad \Delta_O\ \text{is dataset/theory-version dependent}
established_status: H0, muon g-2, the CDF II W mass, selected CKM/flavour quantities and DESI dark-energy fits deserve continued scrutiny. Their status is not uniform and changes with data/theory updates.
not_a_claim: No watchlist entry is a universal fatal gate for every successor theory; fitting one at the cost of established domains is failure.
resolution_evidence: Independent replication, stable theory control, pre-registered combinations and a coherent correlated explanation across observables.
successor_obligation: Declare which tension is targeted, freeze the data/theory version and report global-fit degradation elsewhere.
